items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: And Johnny Handley heard me play saxophone and he was so enthused over my saxophone playing that he put his clarinet down and he then got him a saxophone.

ctx.x: And Johnny Handley heard me play saxophone and he was so enthused over my saxophone playing that he put his clarinet down and he then got him a saxophone.
I never knew that. I didn't know he picked that up there.
